disclaimer.title: Important Notice

content.p1: This application does not upload any data to a server. All data is stored locally in your browser only.
content.p2: Clearing browser data, using private/incognito mode, or switching devices may result in permanent data loss.
content.p3: Please make sure to regularly back up your data using the "$t(profile.export)" button in the top-right corner.
content.p4: The developer is not responsible for any data loss and cannot assist with data recovery.

profile-switch-mode.title: Switch Tracking Mode
profile-switch-mode.to-count: Switch to multi-count mode. Checked items will be recorded as quantity 1.
profile-switch-mode.to-standard: Switch to standard mode. Items with quantity 1 or more will be shown as checked.
profile-switch-mode.to-standard-warn: Items with quantity 2 or more will all be reduced to 1. Count data will be lost. This cannot be undone.

ios-data-warning.body: Due to Apple ITP restrictions, saved data may be deleted after 7 days of inactivity. Please export a backup using the "$t(profile.export)" button in the top right after each use.
